description: Out-of-stock and low-stock products in one call, with counts. Scope: `woo:analytics:read`. `low_stock_threshold` defaults to the store's own low-stock setting. Only stock-managed products can be low, so unmanaged products are counted separately rather than reported as zero.

site.description: Site alias to target (e.g. "guns2ammo"). Omit when only one site is configured.

name: bridgistic_woo_inventory_status
title: WooCommerce inventory status
